name: LAGENDA
recent: Lagenda 正在推进以 RM543.16 million 向 Epicon Berhad 出售 Rantau Urusan 和 LPB Construction 各 60% 股权的提案，并已发出 EGM 通知。公司持续在公开市场回购股份，同时于 9 月完成 RM475 million 的首笔 sukuk 发行。最新季度（2026 年 6 月止）营收和净利均实现环比和同比增长。
notable: 拟以 RM543.16 million 向 Epicon Berhad 出售 Rantau Urusan 和 LPB Construction 各 60% 股权，并附带剩余 40% 股权的认购期权。
发出 EGM 通知，将于 2026 年 12 月 8 日寻求股东批准上述资产出售及相关财务援助。
2026 年 9 月完成 RM475 million 的首笔 sukuk 发行。
risks: 资产出售涉及发行大量 Epicon 新股及 RCPS，Epicon 股东面临股权摊薄。
拟向 RUSB 和 LPBC 提供财务援助，需股东在 EGM 上批准。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月止季度营收 RM336.2 million，环比增长 28.3%，同比增长 40.8%；净利 RM56.6 million，环比增长 28.1%，同比增长 25.0%；净利率 16.8%，与上季度的 16.9% 基本持平。

recent_en: Lagenda is proceeding with the proposed disposal of 60% equity interest in Rantau Urusan and LPB Construction to Epicon Berhad for RM543.16 million, with an EGM notice issued. The company continues share buybacks and completed its first sukuk issuance of RM475 million in September. The latest quarter (ended June 2026) saw revenue and net profit grow both QoQ and YoY.
notable_en: Proposed disposal of 60% equity interest each in Rantau Urusan and LPB Construction to Epicon Berhad for RM543.16 million, with a call option for the remaining 40%.
EGM notice issued to seek shareholder approval on 8 December 2026 for the disposal and related financial assistance.
Completed first sukuk issuance of RM475 million in September 2026.
risks_en: The disposal involves issuance of a large number of new Epicon shares and RCPS, resulting in dilution for Epicon shareholders.
Proposed financial assistance to RUSB and LPBC requires shareholder approval at the EGM.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended June 2026, revenue was RM336.2 million, up 28.3% QoQ and 40.8% YoY; net profit was RM56.6 million, up 28.1% QoQ and 25.0% YoY; net margin was 16.8%, roughly flat versus 16.9% in the prior quarter.
